scenes.title: Bulk and Conciseness
scenes.summary: Bulk comes from using a description instead of a name, metaphors and epithets, making one into many as the poets do (“to Achaean harbors”), giving each word its own article, and using connectives; conciseness from the opposites.

scenes.title: Description by Negation
scenes.summary: Antimachus' way of describing a thing by what it does not have, as he does with Teumessus, amplifies without limit; the poets' “stringless” and “lyreless” song is the same device, well liked in metaphors by analogy.

quotations.cite: Aristotle's examples of bulk and conciseness
